claim_text: Nearly 130,000 utility customers across Indiana remained without power by midday Sunday 16 August 2026, down from a peak of around 300,000, according to the state homeland security spokesperson and the online utility tracker PowerOutage.us.
quote: Nearly 130,000 utility customers statewide remained without power by midday Sunday, down from a peak of around 300,000, according to Woods and the online utility tracker PowerOutage.us.
